predictions.articleTitle: Stevenage vs Fulham U21 Prediction & Tactical Breakdown: Can Senior Physicality Punish Academy Flaws?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Stevenage for a regulation Home Win alongside Over 2.5 total goals as senior penalty-box physicality meets an open academy defense.

bqc.comment: Stevenage have led at half-time in both group wins while Fulham U21 trailed at the break in both defeats, making Win-Win primary and Draw-Win the rotational secondary branch.

spf.comment: Stevenage's rotational cup attack has scored eight goals in two Group B wins and holds a decisive physical edge over an eliminated U21 backline conceding 4.50 goals per game.

goals.comment: Four goals (19.4%) and three goals (18.3%) represent the two highest-probability exact goal totals in the 4.25-lambda distribution.

score.comment: Stevenage's multi-goal cup firepower combined with host goalkeeper rotation points to 3:1 and 2:1 as the primary scoreline convergence points.

over_under.comment: A combined Poisson lambda of 4.25 (2.95 home vs 1.30 away) and 79.6% probability for 3+ goals strongly support Over 2.5.
